+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
+
+def save_observation(res, name):
+    d = OUT / name
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (d / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, img in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(img).save(d / f'{cam}.png')
+    for cam, depth in res.depth.items():
+        np.save(d / f'{cam}_depth.npy', depth)
+    return d
+
+def show_snapshot():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+    res = robot.get_obs(cameras=list(spec['cameras']), include_depth=True, video='none')
+    save_observation(res, 'initial')
+    canvas = Image.new('RGB', (320*3, 270*2), (20, 20, 20))
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
+    for i, (name, img) in enumerate(res.last.items()):
+        x, y = (i%3)*320, (i//3)*270
+        canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(img), (x,y+25))

+    print(json.dumps({'time_left_s':res.meta.get('time_left_s'), 'proprio':res.meta['proprio'], 'cameras':res.meta['cameras']}, indent=2))
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    show_snapshot()
